URL: https://www.ons.gov.uk/economy/inflationandpriceindices/bulletins/consumerpriceinflation/june2026
NOTE: ONS primary bulletin — June 2026 CPI. Headline 2.6% (from 2.8% May), monthly 0.1%, core 2.6% (unchanged), CPIH 2.8% (from 3.0%), services 3.6% (from 3.7%). Drivers: motor fuels (diesel -10.7p/litre m/m, petrol -2.1p), food & non-alcoholic drinks slowed to 1.7% (lowest since Aug 2024; chocolate, oils/fats, dairy fell), clothing -0.5% y/y / -1.2% m/m on summer sales. Lowest headline since Dec 2024 / Mar 2025; below consensus 2.7%.
